WHERE p.active = TRUE

mapper.select: SELECT * FROM welfare_support_product WHERE external_id = #{externalId} AND active = TRUE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO welfare_support_product ( external_id, product_name, institution_name, support_target, age_condition, welfare_type, support_content, application_method, responsible_institution, related_url, active, source_updated_at, synced_at ) VALUES ( #{externalId}, #{productName}, #{institutionName}, #{supportTarget}, #{ageCondition}, #{welfareType}, #{supportContent}, #{applicationMethod}, #{responsibleInstitution}, #{relatedUrl}, #{active}, #{sourceUpdatedAt}, #{syncedAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE product_name = VALUES(product_name), institution_name = VALUES(institution_name), support_target = VALUES(support_target), age_condition = VALUES(age_condition), welfare_type = VALUES(welfare_type), support_content = VALUES(support_content), application_method = VALUES(application_method), responsible_institution = VALUES(responsible_institution), related_url = VALUES(related_url), active = VALUES(active), source_updated_at = VALUES(source_updated_at), synced_at = VALUES(synced_at)
